description: Source code implementing Vulkan backend for LSTM in PyTorch, including functions for LSTM input processing, context packing/unpacking, and execution.

classes.name: LstmPackedContext
classes.description: Class representing packed context for Vulkan LSTM, including methods for packing/unpacking parameters and creating instances.

methods.name: lstm_input
methods.description: Processes input tensors and parameters to produce LSTM outputs, hidden states, and cell states.

methods.name: pack_lstm_linear_op_contexts
methods.description: Creates packed linear operation contexts for each LSTM layer from CPU parameters.

methods.name: LstmPackedContext::pack
methods.description: Serializes LSTM packed context into a generic list for storage or transfer.

methods.name: LstmPackedContext::unpack
methods.description: Deserializes stored context into a usable LSTM packed context object.

methods.name: create_lstm_context
methods.description: Creates a new LSTM packed context from parameters and configuration.

methods.name: run_lstm_context
methods.description: Executes the Vulkan LSTM using input, hidden, and cell states along with the packed context.
